claims.text: 'The incident gave birth to the Aztec UFO Symposium, which was run by the Aztec, New Mexico, library as a fundraiser from 1997 until 2011.' Revisionist defences were published by Scott Ramsey, Suzanne Ramsey and Frank Thayer as 'The Aztec Incident: Recovery at Hart Canyon' and 'The Aztec UFO Incident'.
